purpose: One-direction layered gameplay slice for the selected B motion language; validates body animation, weapon occlusion, grip and muzzle sockets before 24-direction expansion.
camera: single orthographic camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees; locked for every action frame
facing: down-right at 45 degrees clockwise from screen-right, direction index 3 of the approved 24-direction contract
lighting: stable controlled cyan rim light, tiny magenta functional accents, warm orange weapon emission
prompt: Edit the selected B 6-column by 5-row motion sheet into a rigorously aligned body-only technical animation sheet. Preserve the exact chronological poses, compact armored identity, down-right yaw, 45-degree orthographic camera, proportions, scale, and B motion cadence for idle, run, fire, dash, and hit. Remove only the rifle, muzzle flashes, shells, speed trails, dust, and hit bursts. Reconstruct the hidden torso and forearms. Keep both gloved hands posed around the same invisible two-hand rifle grip so a separate rifle layer can be placed back into the hands. Use a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background with no shadows, text, dividers, borders, or extra objects.
negative_constraints: no camera, yaw, identity, action order, or cadence changes
no rifle, muzzle flash, shell, trail, dust, hit burst, or extra object
no relaxed arms; hands must retain a credible two-hand firing grip
no duplicated frames or bob-only animation
no green inside the subject, cast shadow, text, watermark, border, or grid line

references.role: selected B action cadence, exact row order, poses, and fixed down-right projection
approved body-only identity and matching down-right weapon projection
YouMind 27303 tactical armor and weapon-hand relationship reference

generation_model: imagegen built-in plus local chroma-key removal and deterministic Pillow layer/socket packing
weapon_prompt: Create one isolated orange-and-black compact sci-fi rifle matching the approved player weapon. Show the rifle alone with no hands, character, effects, muzzle flash, shadow, or stand. Lock the same down-right yaw and exact 45-degree orthographic camera used by the selected player frame, so the barrel points toward screen-right with the correct slight vertical foreshortening. Use a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background and keep the complete weapon centered with generous padding.
